commitResults.messageBody:
The view command puts all contact details in the 100px feedback box.

Long details are cramped and disappear with subsequent feedback.

Move details into a resizable, scrollable side panel. Keep the feedback
box and adjust window sizing for smaller, scaled screens.

This keeps details readable alongside command feedback.

Command tests and Checkstyle pass. No GUI tests are added. Resolution
and scaling checks remain manual.

commitResults.messageTitle: Highlight the contact opened by view
commitResults.messageBody:
After a successful view, the details only appear in the result box.
The list gives no sign of which card they belong to, so the user
loses track of the contact once they scroll.

Let's carry the row to highlight in CommandResult and have
MainWindow select it in PersonListPanel. The highlight is cleared
after every successful command, and failed commands leave it alone.

Carrying it in CommandResult follows the existing design, where the
result describes UI actions. It also avoids the UI inspecting the
command text, and a stale index can never mark a different person.
